posts.title: Why Building Mobile Apps Is So Much Harder Than It Looks
posts.description: Mobile development looks simple from the outside—but it's one of the most demanding areas in software engineering. With limited resources, strict platform rules, and sky-high user expectations, building great mobile apps takes far more than just writing UI code.

posts.title: Swift: Comparing Enums With Associated Values
posts.description: Comparing enums in Swift is very straightforward – as long as they don’t have associated values. In this post, we will discuss what you can do in that case.
